metadata.question: Did Lac Rouge shrink by more than 90% between June 21, 2024 and June 15, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lac Rouge is a lake in Canada (Quebec) - Need to locate it: approximately 46.95°N, 74.43°W - Compare water extent between June 21, 2024 and June 15, 2025 - Use Sentinel-2 for water detection (10m resolution) - Date ranges: June 2024 (around June 21) and June 2025 (around June 15) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA60 band for Sentinel-2 - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water - NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) - Water typically has NDWI > 0 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Calculate water area in both periods - If collection is empty → C1 - If no valid pixels after cloud masking → C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - If water shrinkage > 90% → A (Yes) - Otherwise → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lacRouge = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.43, 46.95]).buffer(2000); const date2024Start = '2024-06-15'; const date2024End = '2024-06-28'; const date2025Start = '2025-06-08'; const date2025End = '2025-06-22'; // 2. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBit = 1 << 10; const cirrusBit = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Water detection function function addNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } // 4. Data Acquisition for 2024 let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lacRouge) .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDWI); const size2024 = await col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Images found: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log("No data for June 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Data Acquisition for 2025 let col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lacRouge) .filterDate(date2025Start, date2025End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDWI); const size2025 = await col2025.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2025 Images found: ${size2025}`); if (size2025 === 0) { console.log("No data for June 2025."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 6. Create composite images const img2024 = col2024.median(); const img2025 = col2025.median(); // 7. Detect water (NDWI > 0) const water2024 = img2024.select('NDWI').gt(0); const water2025 = img2025.select('NDWI').gt(0); // 8. Calculate water area const stats2024 = await water2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lacRouge, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2024 = stats2024.NDWI_sum || 0; const totalPixels2024 = stats2024.NDWI_count || 0; console.log(`2024: Water pixels=${waterPixels2024}, Total=${totalPixels2024}`); if (totalPixels2024 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2024 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } const stats2025 = await water2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lacRouge, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2025 = stats2025.NDWI_sum || 0; const totalPixels2025 = stats2025.NDWI_count || 0; console.log(`2025: Water pixels=${waterPixels2025}, Total=${totalPixels2025}`); if (totalPixels2025 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels for 2025 after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 9. Calculate shrinkage percentage if (waterPixels2024 === 0) { console.log("No water detected in 2024 baseline."); console.log("C3"); return; } const shrinkagePercent = ((waterPixels2024 - waterPixels2025) / waterPixels2024) * 100; console.log(`Shrinkage: ${shrinkagePercent.toFixed(2)}%`); // 10. Final Answer if (shrinkagePercent > 90) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
